latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Script Automaton — quickly generate scripts and produce video files from your text or topic.

- Automates AI-generated video scripts and exports 1080p MP4, MOV, TXT, or DOCX up to 200MB.
- Supports uploading files, batch processing, and iterative editing—users can refine scripts and preview timeline changes.
- Integrates with a cloud render pipeline for fast processing (20–40 seconds for typical jobs).
- Simple onboarding: auto-generates credentials if no token is found and handles session setup seamlessly.
- Exposes export, credits, status, and upload actions through guided prompts in multiple languages.
- Robust error handling for sessions, tokens, credits, and file uploads with clear, actionable messages.
